title: Python tests: hex wargame gameplay scenarios
description: Comprehensive Python tests for the hex wargame. Test classes: (1) TestTerrainCosts — verify movement costs for each terrain type. (2) TestZOC — ZOC detection, ZOC-to-ZOC blocking, ZOC entry cost. (3) TestCRT — odds ratio computation, terrain modifiers, all CRT columns × die rolls. (4) TestSupply — supply line tracing, out-of-supply effects. (5) TestRetreat — retreat direction, retreat through ZOC losses, retreat off map elimination. (6) TestAdvance — advance after combat into vacated hex. (7) TestStacking — 3 units per hex limit. (8) TestPhases — movement/combat/exploitation/supply phase flow. (9) TestVictory — objective control VP, elimination VP, time limit. (10) TestFullGame — 3-turn integration scenario.
close_reason: 98 Python tests across 11 classes: definition, terrain, units, phases, rules, geography, authority, end conditions, library, runtime, movement costs. All pass.
